dcterms:description: The NICTA-PIBOSO dataset contains 1,000 medical abstracts manually annotated with an extension of the PICO tagset. It includes both structured abstracts with section headings and unstructured abstracts, allowing for multiclass multilabel classification tasks.
dcterms:title: NICTA-PIBOSO Dataset
